newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Yeltsin works on papers, no meetings planned.
newsitem.headline: Yeltsin works on papers, no meetings planned.

text.p: President Boris Yeltsin, recovering from double pneumonia at a government residence outside Moscow, has no meetings planned for Tuesday but will work on state papers at his country home, the Kremlin said.

A spokesman had no new information on the president's health. Officials said on Monday that Yeltsin was moving from hospital to the Gorky-9 residence and would continue his treatment for pneumonia there.
No pictures have been released of Yeltsin since he was taken ill, but aides insist he plans to complete a full schedule of events in the coming weeks.
The programme includes a summit of the Commonwealth of Independent States and a visit to a European Commission meeting in the Netherlands.
Yeltsin, ill first with heart problems and then with pneumonia, has spent only a few days at his Kremlin desk since he was re-elected on July 3. He had heart surgery on November 5.
